title: Barcelona’s first selection dilemmas arrive in midfield ahead of Valencia clash
tweet: Four fit midfielders—Pedri, Gavi, Bernal, Rodri—await selection before Valencia; as things stand, Pedri and Rodri have the strongest claim, but Gavi's energy and Bernal's consistency give Flick credible alternatives. Remains to be seen which pairing he chooses.

title: Report – Barcelona director always anticipated for Atletico Madrid’s blockade over Julian Alvarez
tweet: Deco had long mapped out a fallback for Álvarez: Gordon’s dual‑role play, Hamza’s emerging centre‑forward fire, and the €10m Jesus arrival. As things stand, Barça avoided being stranded at the striker spot.
